subject: Partner credit reconciliation: CloudFoundry Accelerator - escrow vs applied
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@cloudfoundry.org>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Luke.H@cloudfoundry.org; finance@cloudfoundry.org
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator credits — reconciliation request

Hi Rishi,

Hope you're well. We're finalizing Q1 billing for the CloudFoundry Accelerator cohort and noticed a discrepancy between the promo credits we expected to be applied to the trial instances and what shows on our invoice. The cohort was supposed to get 50k token credits under the co-fund agreement (signed Feb 18).

Can you help reconcile which credits were held in escrow vs which were actually applied to customer trials? I can share the ledger we pulled on our end (spreadsheet attached) — highlights on rows 12-24 show where our numbers diverge.

We need to close our books by Apr 20; a short note from Redwood confirming applied amounts would be ideal.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Partnerships Lead — CloudFoundry Accelerator
elena@cloudfoundry.org

--- attachment: cf_accelerator_credit_log.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB) ---

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@cloudfoundry.org>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — reconciliation request

Elena — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. Looping in Priyom and Grace from partner ops & account management to help with line-item reconciliation and to confirm any escrow releases.

Quick notes from our side:
- We show the co-fund agreement on file and an escrow pool of 60k tokens for the cohort.
- Applied credits on trial accounts (customer-facing) appear as per-trial allocations; there are some small rounding adjustments when we map tokens to billable units which might explain part of the delta.

Priyom / Grace — can you take the attached ledger and map the applied credits back to the escrow entries? If possible, please confirm a single number (total applied) and whether the remaining escrow should be returned to CloudFoundry or left for an extension. Elena is aiming to close by Apr 20.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, elena@cloudfoundry.org
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — reconciliation request

On Tue, Apr 10, 2028 at 10:01 AM rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai wrote:
> Priyom / Grace — can you take the attached ledger and map the applied credits back to the escrow entries?

Thanks Rishi — Elena, I pulled the ledger and ran a quick match against our escrow ledger. Short version: we can account for 48,700 of the 50,000 tokens being applied; the remaining ~1,300 is due to rounding/conversions and one trial that auto-expired before allocation because the tenant's billing contact never accepted the trial invite.

Action items I propose:
- Grace to confirm which tenant auto-expired so Elena can notify the cohort admin.
- Finance (Neha) to confirm whether we should treat the ~1,300 as a reversal to the escrow or as a waived amount under the co-fund terms.
- Rishi to confirm if CloudFoundry wants the remaining escrow returned or to keep it for a 30-day extension.

I'll attach the reconciliation sheet (two tabs: escrow_match, exceptions) in my next email.

— Priyom
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

--- attachment: reconciliation_export_20280411.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB) ---

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: elena@cloudfoundry.org, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — reconciliation request

Elena / team — I reviewed the exceptions tab. The tenant that auto-expired is: cohort-tenant-0817 (owner: mike@openstacklabs.com). The invite was sent Feb 27 and never accepted; we can either re-provision the trial and apply the leftover credits (1,300 tokens) or reverse to escrow.

Elena, which would you prefer operationally? If you want us to re-provision we can do so within 24–48 hours and apply the credits immediately — you'll just need to confirm the trial owner email to re-send invite.

Grace O'Connor
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai

From: finance@cloudfoundry.org <finance@cloudfoundry.org>

Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator credits — reconciliation request

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per our internal policy we prefer returned escrow to be reconciled back to the sponsor if it is not explicitly applied. That said, because this was a small auto-expiry, we're OK with Redwood re-provisioning the trial and applying the remaining 1,300 tokens so long as we get a short confirmation note for our records.

Please confirm once applied and upload a one-line acknowledgement to the drive folder you were given (see HubSpot deal link).

Best,
Luke Harrington
Finance Manager, CloudFoundry Accelerator
finance@cloudfoundry.org
